content: 1. It is important to be aware of all the medications you are taking. Maintain a list of your medications and share it with your doctor or pharmacist whenever you are prescribed a new medication. 2. To take telmisartan tablets: Follow your doctor’s instructions precisely regarding how to take telmisartan. Your doctor will determine the appropriate dose and timing for you. Do not alter your dose unless instructed by your doctor. Take telmisartan tablets once daily at the same time each day. You may take telmisartan tablets with or without food. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular schedule. Do not double the dose. If you take an excessive amount of telmisartan, contact your doctor or go to the nearest emergency room immediately. Before using telmisartan tablets, read the “How to Open the Blister” instructions provided in the leaflet. Consult your doctor if you have any questions or do not understand the instructions. 3. Potential side effects of telmisartan tablets include: Serious risks such as harm or death to an unborn baby. Low blood pressure (hypotension), which is more likely if you: Take diuretics (water pills). Follow a low-salt diet. Undergo dialysis treatments. Have heart problems. Experience vomiting or diarrhea. If you feel faint or dizzy, lie down and contact your doctor immediately. Worsening kidney problems, especially if you already have kidney disease. This may result in changes in your kidney test results, and your doctor may need to adjust your dose. Contact your doctor if you experience: Swelling in your feet, ankles, or hands. Unexplained weight gain. High potassium levels in the blood (hyperkalemia). Your doctor may monitor your potassium levels as needed. Rare but serious allergic reactions. Notify your doctor immediately if you experience: Swelling of the face, tongue, or throat. Difficulty breathing. Skin rash. Common side effects include sinus pain and congestion (sinusitis), back pain, and diarrhea. These are not all the possible side effects. Inform your doctor if you experience any side effects that bother you or do not resolve. For medical advice about side effects, contact your doctor. You may also report side effects to the FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088. 4. To store telmisartan tablets: Keep them at a temperature between 59°F and 86°F (15°C to 30°C). Do not remove the tablets from their blister packaging until just before use. Store telmisartan tablets and all medications out of the reach of children. 5. General information about telmisartan tablets: Medications are sometimes prescribed for uses not listed in the patient information leaflet. Do not use telmisartan tablets for a condition for which they were not prescribed. Do not share telmisartan tablets with others, even if they have the same condition as you. It may harm them. This leaflet summarizes the most important information about telmisartan tablets. For more details, consult your doctor or pharmacist. You can also request information written for healthcare professionals. 6. Ingredients in telmisartan tablets: Active ingredient: telmisartan USP. Inactive ingredients: croscarmellose sodium, lactose monohydrate, magnesium stearate, meglumine, povidone, and sodium hydroxide pellets. 7. High blood pressure (hypertension) is the force exerted by your blood against your blood vessels when your heart beats and rests. High blood pressure occurs when this force is excessive. Telmisartan tablets help relax your blood vessels, lowering your blood pressure. Lowering blood pressure reduces the risk of stroke and heart attack. Untreated high blood pressure can lead to stroke, heart attack, heart failure, kidney failure, and vision problems. 8. Instructions for opening the blister packaging: Tear: You may also use scissors to tear the blister apart. Peel: Remove the paper layer from the aluminum foil. Push: Push the tablet through the foil.
